scope: Guarded app-only installation, flash device-checksum verification, and serial boot-health evidence for units A and B. Multiplayer runtime and gameplay acceptance are separate and remain pending in this record.
selected_scope:
App-only 0.67 successor for the separately backed-up and checksum-bound Tab5 A/ST7121 and B/ST7123. Preserve pinned SDK/components, bootloader, partition table, OTA selector, NVS, settings, SD content, native game packages and protected game lineage. Retain protocol-7 fresh and returning admission to an already-running Doom Arena host, paced replay, verified storage, bounded music-control admission and explicit SCORE/break restoration.

Optimize the Tab5 frame path by having the Doom palette writer acquire and fill the existing bounded immutable PSRAM display-worker lease directly, composing overlays in that lease and publishing ownership without an intermediate whole-frame copy. Fuse XRGB8888 conversion and 320x200-to-384x240 prescaling in the worker, retaining platform-owned PPA rotation, scanout retirement and exact CPU fallback. Enable fusion by default for the Tab5 build with an explicit OFF option. Preserve acquire/cancel/failure/teardown ownership and legacy weak-hook behavior.

Cache renderer source/colormap pointers in O2 loops without changing pixels or simulation. Add owner-task engine-phase timing counters to identify remaining bottlenecks. Suppress only the duplicate live READY send for the same cursor after a successful immediate send in the same poll; preserve retries, loading, replay, activation and live acknowledgements.

Add an optional quarter-linear-resolution immutable debug framebuffer snapshot to shorten remote inspection transfers. Keep default full-resolution capture and its ownership/lifetime contract. Scale-four captures transfer 115200 RGB565 bytes and produce 320x180 landscape images; exclude their complete transfer intervals, just as for full snapshots, from cadence measurements. The screenshot change adds no per-frame work.

Bind exact final runtime/build/test inputs and retain scoped patch reviews and combined-source checks. Hardware acceptance remains separate: both host directions, fresh late guest, repeated guest departure/rejoin while host progress continues without another Start, score/break close restoration, correlated music/SFX activity and speaker confirmation, and representative active cadence at least 25 FPS per the latest user request while aiming for 30 FPS and retaining the repository 30 FPS release floor. Test all nine other multiplayer games afterward with exact installed package and device bindings. A successful build, flash, counter or framebuffer transfer alone is not complete physical gameplay or acoustic acceptance. Long-match replay capacity and linear catch-up limits remain documented rather than silently represented as unlimited; separate future changes are not included here.
